ai_impact_table.ai_head_sub: AI can automate mixing, reduce noise, and generate captions, but when a live stream drops or a microphone feeds back, the audience and presenter need a technician's hands and ears on site.
ai_impact_table.ai_s1_bls: U.S. Bureau of Labor Statistics (BLS) data show about 92,300 Audio and Video Technicians employed in 2024. Employment is projected to reach 95,400 by 2034, a net increase of about 3,100 jobs, with roughly 7,300 openings per year. Median annual pay was about $54,800 in 2026 (BLS OOH, 2026).
ai_impact_table.ai_s1_p: AI will not replace audio and video technicians, but it will simplify part of the technical workflow. Automated mixing, AI noise reduction, caption generation, and automated video switching are spreading. Equipment setup, testing, and emergency recovery require someone physically present. Live streams and performances cannot wait for AI processing.
ai_s2_accel: AI-assisted multi-camera switching
Integrated audio and video processing in intelligent conference systems
Adoption of cloud-based live production and low-latency transmission
Acoustic simulation tools for on-site tuning
ai_s2_auto: Automated mixing and AI noise reduction
Automated caption generation and transcription
Automated live-stream delivery and multi-platform distribution
Equipment parameter memory and scene presets
ai_s3_list: Live recovery: respond to dropped streams, feedback, and black screens.
Trained eyes and ears: judge tone and visual details.
Equipment dexterity: muscle memory with mixing and switching consoles.
Workflow coordination: work smoothly with directors, presenters, and guests.
Stamina and resilience: remain effective while wiring equipment late at night.
ai_impact_table.ai_s4_p: A score of 5/10, moderate, reflects fast automation at the signal-processing layer. AI can handle mixing, noise reduction, captions, and streaming, but live production takes place in the physical world. People move equipment, route cables, and recover from failures. A technician's value is on site.
ai_impact_table.ai_s4_p2: Moderate exposure does not make the work easy. AI simplifies repetitive operations and displaces technicians who only follow presets. Technicians who use AI tools, understand acoustics, and solve live failures are in strong demand across streaming and performance production.

ai_s5_persona.建议: Vocational or associate programs in film production and audio engineering provide an entry point, but hands-on equipment experience matters more than credentials alone. Late nights, physical work, and variable income make this career a better fit for students who genuinely enjoy equipment.

Add live-stream delivery, cloud production, and AI tools to build a combined skill set across audio, video, streaming, and content technology. Lighting or audio industry certifications can qualify technicians for larger projects.

People with electrical, live performance, or video-editing backgrounds can transition quickly. Start as a technical assistant for small events or streaming rooms. Documenting hands-on work with two equipment setups is more useful than simply claiming a passion for audio and video.

Technician turnover is high. Retain staff with transparent per-event pay, equipment assignments that follow the technician, and a path to technical director. During hiring, ask candidates to wire a setup and mix audio on site instead of relying on a resume alone.

ai_s6_tools.代表能力: Automatically select cameras based on visual content
Integrated sound capture, amplification, recording, and streaming

ai_s7_trends: Routine live streams and online events continue to increase demand for audio and video technicians.
AI mixing, noise reduction, and automated switching are becoming standard, shifting technicians toward on-site and creative work.
Integrated intelligent equipment lowers the technical barrier for small events.

body: Audio And Video Technicians install, test, operate, and maintain sound, lighting, video, and live-stream equipment. They work across concerts, live streams, conferences, recordings, and broadcasts, protecting audio and visual quality and keeping the production workflow moving.
career_ai_description_block.heading: AI can automate mixing, reduce noise, and generate captions, but when a live stream drops or a microphone feeds back, the audience and presenter need a technician's hands and ears on site.

ai_impact_table.ai_head_sub: AI 能自动混音、降噪、生成字幕，但直播断了、话筒啸叫了那一下，观众和主播都等着，还是得技术员的手和耳朵现场救场。
ai_impact_table.ai_s1_bls: 美国劳工统计局（BLS） 的数据显示，2024 年音频视频技术员在岗约 9.23 万人，到 2034 年预计升至 9.54 万人，净增约 0.31 万个岗位，年均产生约 0.73 万个职位空缺，2026 年中位数年薪约 5.48 万美元（BLS OOH，2026）。
ai_impact_table.ai_s1_p: AI 不会取代音频视频技术员，但会简化一部分技术活：自动混音、AI 降噪、字幕生成、自动导播都在普及。现场设备搭建、调试和救场是「人到场、手到设备」的活，直播和演出不允许「等 AI 处理」。
ai_s2_accel: AI 自动导播辅助多机位切换
智能会议系统一体化音视频处理
云端直播与低延迟传输技术普及
声学仿真工具辅助现场调校
ai_s2_auto: 自动混音与 AI 降噪处理
字幕自动生成与转写
直播推流与多平台分发自动化
设备参数记忆与场景预设
ai_s3_list: 现场救场：断流、啸叫、黑屏的临场处置。
耳朵与眼睛：对音色、画面细节的判断。
设备手感：调音台、导播台的肌肉记忆。
流程配合：跟导演、主播、嘉宾的默契。
体力与抗压：熬夜布线还能状态在线。
ai_impact_table.ai_s4_p: 5/10 说明这行的自动化在「信号处理层」走得比较快：混音、降噪、字幕、推流都能交给 AI，但现场是物理世界，设备要人搬、线要人走、故障要人救，技术员的价值在「现场」。
ai_impact_table.ai_s4_p2: 中风险不等于轻松：AI 会简化重复操作，但也会淘汰「只会按预设操作」的技术员。能玩转 AI 工具、懂声学原理、能现场救场的复合型技术员，反而是直播和演出行业抢着要的人。

ai_s5_persona.建议: 技校、大专的影视制作、音响工程专业是入口，但别迷信学历，多跟场攒设备经验更重要。这行熬夜、辛苦、收入波动，适合真心喜欢设备的孩子。
把直播推流、云端制作、AI 工具补起来，往「音视频 + 直播 + 内容技术」的复合方向走。考个灯光、音响相关的行业认证，接大型项目的资格就有了。
有电工、演出、影视剪辑背景的人转行最快。先从小型活动、直播间的技术助理做起，攒两台设备的实战案例，比空谈「热爱音视频」有用。
技术员流动性大，用「场次费透明 + 设备跟人 + 晋升到技术总监」留人。招聘时让他现场接一次线、调一次音，比看简历靠谱。

ai_s6_tools.代表能力: 多通道混音与场景记忆
多机位切换与信号调度
按画面内容自动切机位

ai_s7_trends: 直播与线上活动的常态化让音视频技术岗需求持续增长。
AI 混音、降噪、自动导播成为标配，技术员转向现场与创意。
一体化智能设备普及，小型活动的技术门槛在降低。

body: 音频视频技术员负责音响、灯光、视频、直播等音视频设备的安装、调试、操作与维护，覆盖演唱会、直播、会议、录播、转播等多种场景，保障现场音画质量和流程顺畅。
career_ai_description_block.heading: AI 能自动混音、降噪、生成字幕，但直播断了、话筒啸叫了那一下，观众和主播都等着，还是得技术员的手和耳朵现场救场。

ai_impact_table.ai_head_sub: AI can label heart rate and calculate ejection fraction in seconds, but technicians still determine whether electrodes are placed correctly and whether procedural support is steady.
ai_impact_table.ai_s1_bls: According to the U.S. Bureau of Labor Statistics (BLS), about 64,700 Cardiovascular technologists and technicians were employed in 2024. Employment is projected to rise to 66,600 by 2034, a net gain of about 1,900 jobs, with approximately 3,800 openings each year. Median annual pay is about $67,300 in 2026 (BLS OOH, 2026).
ai_impact_table.ai_s1_p: AI will not replace Cardiovascular technologists and technicians, but it will assist imaging and measurement. Automated ECG analysis, AI ultrasound measurements, and alerts accelerate initial screening. Technicians are shifting from data collection toward procedural support, interpretation checks, and patient communication. Entry-level workers limited to routine tracing face the greatest pressure. Technicians who assist procedures and understand interpretation are more valuable.
ai_s2_accel: Intelligent alerts for abnormal waveform segments
Structured imaging archives
Real-time tracking of procedural parameters
Simulated interpretation training
ai_s2_auto: Automated ECG analysis and alerts
Automated AI ultrasound measurements
Automated imaging-quality flags
Generated examination-report templates
ai_s3_list: Procedural support: depends on people.
Electrode placement: depends on practiced touch.
Patient communication requires people.
Interpretation checks: depend on experience.
Emergency support: depends on composure.
ai_impact_table.ai_s4_p: A score of 5/10, moderate, places this occupation in a medical technology area where AI assists measurement but people remain essential for procedural support, communication, and interpretation.
ai_impact_table.ai_s4_p2: Moderate exposure brings real change. AI accelerates routine tracing and automated measurements, not catheterization-lab support and interpretation. Technicians who assist procedures and verify results have a more stable role. Entry-level workers who only produce tracings without understanding interpretation face the greatest risk.

ai_s5_persona.建议: Earn an associate degree in medical imaging and gain extensive ECG and ultrasound practice during school. Routine tracing is shrinking in the AI era, so develop procedural-support skills early.
Move beyond tracing into procedural support + interpretation. Learn AI-assisted tools and pursue catheterization-lab work.
Highlight the equipment you can operate and any procedural-support experience. Hospitals value composure and accuracy.
Do not hire on certificates alone. Evaluate whether candidates can coordinate during procedures. Supervising technologists who verify work merit performance pay.

ai_s7_trends: AI-assisted imaging is spreading, reducing routine tracing work.
Demand remains stable for interventional and ultrasound roles.
Technicians who assist procedures and interpret findings are more sought after.

body: Cardiovascular technologists and technicians operate ECG, ultrasound, and interventional equipment. They collect and process cardiac images and physiological signals, assist physicians with angiography, pacing, and other procedures, and monitor patients' vital signs.
career_ai_description_block.heading: AI can label heart rate and calculate ejection fraction in seconds, but technicians still determine whether electrodes are placed correctly and whether procedural support is steady.

ai_impact_table.ai_head_sub: AI 能秒标心率算射血分数，但贴电极贴得准不准、术中配合稳不稳，还是技术员的眼和手去定。
ai_impact_table.ai_s1_bls: 美国劳工统计局（BLS） 的数据显示，2024 年心血管技师与技术员在岗约 6.47 万人，到 2034 年预计升至 6.66 万人，净增约 0.19 万个岗位，年均产生约 0.38 万个职位空缺，2026 年中位数年薪约 6.73 万美元（BLS OOH，2026）。
ai_impact_table.ai_s1_p: AI 不会取代心血管技术员，但会辅助影像与测量。心电图自动分析、超声 AI 测值与预警把初筛提速，技术员从「采数」挪向「术中配合、判读把关、患者沟通」。真正被挤掉的是只做常规描图的初级工，会跟台懂判读的人更值钱。
ai_s2_accel: 异常波段智能提示
影像结构化归档
术中参数实时跟踪
培训模拟判读
ai_s2_auto: 心电图自动分析与预警
超声 AI 自动测值
影像质控自动标记
检查报告模板生成
ai_s3_list: 术中配合：靠人。
贴电极手感：靠练。
患者沟通：靠人。
判读把关：靠经验。
应急配合：靠稳。
ai_impact_table.ai_s4_p: 5/10 说明这个职业处在中高曝光的医疗技术区——测量被辅助，但配合、沟通与判读仍留着人的位置。
ai_impact_table.ai_s4_p2: 中高曝光不等于没变化：被加速的是「常规描图与自动测值」，不是「导管室配合与判读」的岗位。有跟台能力、能把关的技术员，反而更稳。怕的是只会描图、不懂判读的初级工。

ai_s5_persona.建议: 读医学影像类大专，在校多摸心电图和超声。AI 时代纯描图在缩，早点练跟台。
从「描图」升级成「跟台 + 判读」，学 AI 辅助工具，争取进导管室。
突出会哪些设备、有没有跟台经验。医院看重稳和准。
选人别只看证书，要看会不会跟台配合。能把关的主管技师，值得给绩效。

ai_s7_trends: AI 影像辅助普及，描图缩。
介入与超声岗需求稳。
会跟台判读的技术员更抢手。

body: 心血管技师与技术员是心血管技术员与技术员操作心电图、超声与介入设备，采集处理心脏影像与生理信号，配合医生完成造影与起搏等介入操作，并监测患者生命体征。
career_ai_description_block.heading: AI 能秒标心率算射血分数，但贴电极贴得准不准、术中配合稳不稳，还是技术员的眼和手去定。

ai_impact_table.ai_head_sub: AI can calculate the cutting plan that wastes the least material, but an experienced carpenter still needs trained hands and eyes to lever a column that is half a millimeter out of line back into position.
ai_impact_table.ai_s1_bls: According to the U.S. Bureau of Labor Statistics (BLS), about 959,000 Carpenters were employed in 2024. Employment is projected to rise to 1,002,100 by 2034, a net increase of about 43,100 jobs, with approximately 74,100 openings each year. Median annual pay is about $59,300 in 2026 (BLS OOH, 2026).
ai_impact_table.ai_s1_p: AI will not replace Carpenters, but it will take over material calculations and plan reading. Cutting optimization software, AI measurement, and automated drawing generation are absorbing desk-based dimension calculations. Layout, cutting, assembly, and on-site adjustment still require manual craft that machines cannot replace.
ai_s2_accel: Laser measurement and 3D scanning support layout work
CNC cutting equipment improves precision
AR-assisted installation positioning
AI modeling previews for woodworking design
ai_s2_auto: Cutting optimization software automatically calculates material layouts
Automated CAD drawings and construction documents
Automated bills of materials and cost estimates
Systematic tool and material management
ai_s3_list: Layout and on-site judgment: drawings are straight, but almost nothing on site is square, so experience is needed to establish a reference line.
Cutting and assembly technique: accurate cuts and well-fitted joints require years of practice.
On-site adjustment: correcting warps, bows, and wide gaps through controlled leverage depends on feel.
Structural and load-bearing judgment: know where solid wood is essential and where material can be saved.
Coordination with other trades: sequencing work with electricians, plumbers, masons, and painters requires on-site judgment.
ai_impact_table.ai_s4_p: A score of 3/10 places this occupation in the relatively low AI exposure tier. Material calculations, plan reading, and recordkeeping represent a small share of the job; most work is performed by hand on site, leaving limited scope for direct AI replacement.
ai_impact_table.ai_s4_p2: Low exposure does not mean no change. AI mainly helps Carpenters calculate more accurately and reduce waste, shifting material cutting from intuition to data. The greatest pressure falls on labor-intensive workers who cannot read plans, while skilled finish carpenters become more valuable.

ai_s5_persona.建议: For a career in carpentry, vocational school followed by an apprenticeship is the established path. Build strong skills in plan reading, layout, and tool operation. In the AI era, go beyond simply cutting wood by learning CNC cutting and custom furniture design, then move toward finish carpentry.

Use cutting optimization and laser measurement tools because saving material increases profit. Advance toward custom furniture or renovation project management instead of relying only on physical labor.

Start as a renovation apprentice or helper, learning safety before technique. On a resume, results such as independently completing XX cabinet sets or XX square meters of ceiling work with no rework are more useful than simply claiming to work hard.

When hiring Carpenters, assess safety awareness before craftsmanship. Do not hire someone careless about power-saw protection. Carpenters who read plans, understand CNC equipment, and deliver to acceptance standards deserve higher rates.

ai_s6_tools.代表能力: Fast layout plus vertical and horizontal calibration
Automated cutting and consistent batch production
Power saws, power planers, and nail guns
Overlaying drawings on site for positioning
Coordination of schedules, materials, and acceptance

ai_s7_trends: As digital cutting and CNC equipment spread, carpentry is shifting from intuition to data, reducing waste while improving precision.
Growth in custom furniture and high-end renovation is creating clear premiums for finish Carpenters while narrowing opportunities for labor-only roles.
Safety and skill certification requirements are tightening, making credentials and systematic training key dividing lines in the industry.

body: Carpenters use hand and power tools to measure, cut, join, and install wood and related materials according to plans. Their work covers building structures such as formwork and roof frames, interior finishes such as doors, windows, flooring, and ceilings, and furniture production.
career_ai_description_block.heading: AI can calculate the cutting plan that wastes the least material, but an experienced carpenter still needs trained hands and eyes to lever a column that is half a millimeter out of line back into position.

ai_impact_table.ai_head_sub: AI 能算出最省料的切割方案，但现场那根歪了半毫米的柱子怎么借力校直，还得靠老师傅的手和眼。
ai_impact_table.ai_s1_bls: 美国劳工统计局（BLS） 的数据显示，2024 年木工在岗约 95.90 万人，到 2034 年预计升至 100.21 万人，净增约 4.31 万个岗位，年均产生约 7.41 万个职位空缺，2026 年中位数年薪约 5.93 万美元（BLS OOH，2026）。
ai_impact_table.ai_s1_p: AI 不会取代木工，但会接管算料和读图。下料优化软件、AI 测量、图纸自动生成，正在把「算尺寸」的桌面活做掉。剩下的放线、切割、拼装、现场修整，全是手上的手艺，机器替代不了。
ai_s2_accel: 激光测量与 3D 扫描辅助放线
数控切割设备提升精度
AR 辅助安装定位
木作设计的 AI 建模预览
ai_s2_auto: 下料优化软件自动算料排版
CAD 图纸与施工图自动生成
材料清单与预算自动计算
工具与物料管理系统化
ai_s3_list: 放线与现场判断：图纸是直的，现场没有一处是正的，要靠经验找基准。
切割与拼装手法：一刀下去准不准、榫卯合不合，是多年功夫。
现场修整：歪了、翘了、缝大了，怎么借力校回来，靠的是手感。
结构与承重判断：哪些地方必须实木、哪里能省料，心里要有数。
与各工种的配合：水电、瓦工、油漆的衔接，是现场协调的学问。
ai_impact_table.ai_s4_p: 3/10 说明这个职业的算料、读图、记录比重很低——绝大部分工作在现场手上，AI 直接替代的空间有限。
ai_impact_table.ai_s4_p2: 低曝光不等于不变。AI 主要帮你「算得更准、省得更多」，把木工从「凭感觉下料」变成「数据化下料」。真正被挤压的是「不会读图、只会蛮干」的力气型岗位，懂精细木作的师傅反而更值钱。

ai_s5_persona.建议: 想走木工这条路，技校加学徒是正路，把识图、放线和工具操作学扎实。AI 时代别只当「会锯木头的人」，学数控下料、定制家具设计，往精细木作方向走。
把下料优化和激光测量工具用起来，省料就是多赚钱。往定制家具、装修项目经理方向升级，别只靠蛮力接活。
从装修学徒或小工做起，先学会防护再学手艺。简历里多写「独立完成过XX套柜体/XX平吊顶、无返工」这类成果，比一句吃苦耐劳有用。
招木工先问安全意识再看手艺——电锯防护都不讲究的人不能要。会读图、懂数控、能按验收标准交活的师傅，值得给更高工价。

ai_s6_tools.代表能力: 快速放线、垂直水平校准

ai_s7_trends: 数字化下料与数控设备普及，木工从「凭感觉」转向「按数据」，省料又精准。
定制家具与精装修需求增长，精细木作师傅溢价明显，力气型岗位收窄。
安全与技能认证趋严，持证与系统培训成为行业分水岭。

body: 木工使用手工与电动工具，按图纸对木材及相关材料进行测量、切割、拼接与安装，从事建筑结构（模板、屋架）、装修（门窗、地板、吊顶）及家具制作等工作。
career_ai_description_block.heading: AI 能算出最省料的切割方案，但现场那根歪了半毫米的柱子怎么借力校直，还得靠老师傅的手和眼。

ai_impact_table.ai_head_sub: A self-service button can replace form entry, but a clerk still has to explain why an expired document prevents an application from proceeding.
ai_impact_table.ai_s1_bls: The U.S. Bureau of Labor Statistics (BLS) reports that about 180,400 Court, Municipal, And License Clerks were employed in 2024. Employment is projected to reach 185,900 by 2034, a net gain of about 5,500 jobs, with roughly 18,500 openings each year. The median annual wage was about $47,700 in 2026 (BLS OOH, 2026).
ai_impact_table.ai_s1_p: AI will not replace Court, Municipal, And License Clerks, but it will sharply reduce routine intake work. Online services, self-service terminals, and RPA data entry handle standardized cases. Clerks are shifting from keyboard entry toward reviewing complex documents, explaining rules, and managing public interactions. Staff who only collect forms face the greatest pressure. People who understand policy and complex review become more valuable.
ai_s2_accel: Smart customer service and voice assistants that triage inquiries
Policy-profile guidance for public services
Remote video service replacing some counter visits
Real-time alerts for higher-risk cases
ai_s2_auto: Self-service form completion and document entry
Automated RPA validation and data reconciliation
OCR extraction of identification and license fields
Automated blacklist and compliance screening
ai_s3_list: Complex documents and exceptions: people decide how to handle expired identification, missing requirements, and disputed cases.
Compliance and interpersonal judgment: experience and accountability guide rejection or escalation decisions.
Managing public frustration: machines cannot absorb the emotions created by queues and urgent needs.
Paper records and physical licenses: people still handle the documents.
Cross-system coordination: people connect intake, review, and license issuance into one service.
ai_impact_table.ai_s4_p: A score of 5/10 places this career in the moderate AI exposure range for counter services. Systems and self-service terminals can replace many standardized steps, but document review and in-person service still require people.
ai_impact_table.ai_s4_p2: Moderate exposure does not mean high risk for the entire occupation. AI replaces standardized intake, not the full role. Clerks who review complex cases, understand policy, and move into operations become more valuable as smart triage expands. Staff who only collect forms and avoid new systems face the greatest risk.

ai_s5_persona.建议: Build a foundation in secretarial, administrative, or legal studies, then strengthen official writing and office software skills. Routine intake is shrinking in the AI era. Develop policy interpretation and review skills early instead of focusing only on document collection.
Move from collecting documents to reviewing cases and explaining policy. Learn review standards and operations to compete for review supervisor or counter manager roles.
Emphasize attention to detail, policy knowledge, and system proficiency. Describe the complex cases you handled. Counter experience and relevant credentials are advantages.
Do not hire on data-entry speed alone. Assess policy comprehension and error control. Clerks who independently review cases and guide the public merit stronger performance rewards.

Route each case to the appropriate process

Versatile clerks who understand policy, review complex cases, and guide the public will be in greater demand.

ai_impact_table.ai_head_sub: 填表录系统能做成自助按钮，但群众举着一张过期证件问「为啥办不了」，还得办事员解释。
ai_impact_table.ai_s1_bls: 美国劳工统计局（BLS） 的数据显示，2024 年法院、市政、执照文员在岗约 18.04 万人，到 2034 年预计升至 18.59 万人，净增约 0.55 万个岗位，年均产生约 1.85 万个职位空缺，2026 年中位数年薪约 4.77 万美元（BLS OOH，2026）。
ai_impact_table.ai_s1_p: AI 不会取代法院、市政与证照办事员，但会大幅压缩纯受理操作。网办、自助终端、RPA 录入把标准化业务接走了，办事员的时间从「敲键盘」挪向「审核复杂材料、解释规则、经营群众关系」。真正被挤掉的是只会机械收件的办事员，能做复杂审核、懂政策的人更值钱。
ai_s2_accel: 智能客服与语音助手前置分流咨询
政策画像驱动的办事引导
远程视频窗口替代部分临柜
风险件实时预警辅助判断
ai_s2_auto: 表单填报与材料录入的自助化
RPA 自动校对与数据勾稽
OCR 自动识别证件与执照要素
黑名单与合规的自动筛查
ai_s3_list: 复杂材料与异常处置：过期证件、要件不齐、争议件要人定夺。
合规与人际判断：是否退件上报，靠经验和责任心。
群众情绪安抚：排队和急事面前，机器接不住情绪。
纸质与实物证照管理：证照仍要人经手。
跨系统协调：把受理、审核、发证串起来的综合服务。
ai_impact_table.ai_s4_p: 5/10 说明这个职业处在中等 AI 曝光的窗口操作区——大量标准化动作能被系统和自助终端替代，但材料审核与现场服务还留着人的位置。
ai_impact_table.ai_s4_p2: 中高曝光不等于整体高风险：被替代的是「标准化收件」，不是「岗位」。会做复杂审核、懂政策、能转运营的人，反而随智能分流变得更稀缺。怕的是只会收表、不学新系统的办事员。

ai_s5_persona.建议: 文秘行政法律类打底，在校把公文写作和办公软件练熟。AI 时代纯受理在缩，早点练政策解读和审核能力，别只盯着收件。
从「收材料」升级成「审材料 + 解政策」，学审核口径和运营，争取转岗审核主管或窗口负责人。
突出细心、政策熟悉度和系统熟练度，写清处理过哪些复杂件。有窗口经验和证书优先。
招人别只看录入速度，要看政策理解和差错控制。能独立审核、能做群众引导的办事员值得给更高绩效。

ai_s7_trends: 网办与自助终端继续分流标准化受理，窗口向「审核 + 复杂业务」转型。
RPA 与 OCR 让材料录入基本无人化，办事员转向审核与服务。
懂政策、能做复杂审核和群众引导的复合办事员更抢手。

ai_impact_table.ai_head_sub: AI can calculate schedules and production plans, but supervisors still make on-site decisions when a worker becomes ill, equipment fails, or weather changes.
ai_impact_table.ai_s1_bls: According to the U.S. Bureau of Labor Statistics (BLS), employment of First Line Supervisors Of Farming, Fishing, And Forestry Workers is projected to rise from about 65,400 in 2024 to 67,000 in 2034. That is a net increase of about 1,600 jobs, with roughly 8,500 openings each year. The median annual wage is about $59,300 in 2026 (BLS OOH, 2026).
ai_impact_table.ai_s1_p: AI will not replace farming, fishing, and forestry supervisors, but it will change management. Software handles schedules, production calendars, and yield forecasts. Supervisors move from memory-based direction to data-informed command. Field coordination, worker communication, and incident response remain difficult to replace.
ai_s2_accel: AI production advice guides work planning
Drones and remote sensing assist field and forest inspections
Smart livestock or crop platforms provide real-time monitoring
Optimized machinery dispatch and route planning
ai_s2_auto: Digital scheduling, attendance, and piece-rate pay
Digital production records and work logs
Software-based agricultural supply inventory and purchasing
Automated summaries of output and labor hours
ai_s3_list: Field coordination and response: plans change, so the supervisor's value lies on site.
Personnel management and motivation: AI cannot align workers and resolve conflict.
Quality and safety review: people remain responsible for visual and random inspections.
Working alongside the crew: teams respect supervisors who step in at critical moments.
Experience under natural uncertainty: judgment combines weather, markets, and production timing.
ai_impact_table.ai_s4_p: A score of 4/10 places this career in the low-moderate exposure range. Most work occurs on site, limiting standardized automation mainly to scheduling, records, and statistics.
ai_impact_table.ai_s4_p2: Low-moderate exposure still brings change. Digital production planning and smart monitoring require supervisors to read data and use tools. Experience-only verbal management faces pressure. Supervisors who use data and lead people become more valuable.

ai_s5_persona.建议: Study modern agriculture or animal science at a vocational school while building management and digital skills. Large-scale agriculture needs young people who understand technology and management. Begin at a production base.

Use software to manage schedules, production work, and output data. Learn digital agriculture tools. Move from experience-only management to data-informed management and pursue farm or base management.

Experience as a factory team lead or project manager transfers well. State team size, production scheduling, and quality or safety results on your resume. This carries more weight than a general interest in agriculture.
Test field coordination and personnel management when hiring. Use an incident scenario. The strongest candidates use data tools, work well with crews, and accept safety responsibility.

ai_s6_tools.代表能力: Agricultural supply records and purchasing alerts

ai_s7_trends: Large-scale and digital production spreads, moving supervisors from experience-based to data-based management.
Smart machinery and unmanned equipment reduce front-line physical roles, while management positions remain relatively stable.
Stricter food-safety and labor standards increase supervisors' safety and compliance responsibilities.

ai_impact_table.ai_s1_p: AI 不会取代农林牧渔一线主管，但会改变管理方式。排班、农事日历、产量预测都能交给软件，主管从「记在脑子里」变成「看着数据指挥」。真正难以替代的，是现场调度、人员沟通和突发情况的临场处置。

ai_s3_list: 现场调度与应变：计划赶不上变化，主管的价值在现场。
人员管理与激励：把人带顺、把矛盾压下去，AI 做不到。
质量与安全把关：肉眼检查、随机抽查，责任在人。
与工人并肩干活：关键时刻顶上去，团队才服你。
靠天吃饭的经验判断：天气、行情、农时的综合把握。
ai_impact_table.ai_s4_p: 4/10 说明这个职业大部分时间在现场，能被标准化的管理环节有限——主要是排班、记录和数据统计。
ai_impact_table.ai_s4_p2: 中高曝光不等于没变化：数字化排产和智能监控进场后，主管要会看数据、用工具。被压缩的是只靠经验和口头指挥的旧模式，会看数据又会带人的主管更值钱。

ai_s5_persona.建议: 走农业职业院校路线，学现代农业技术或畜牧兽医，同时补管理和数字化技能。规模化农业缺「懂技术 + 会管理」的年轻人，起步从基地做起。
把排班、农事、产量数据用软件管起来，学点农业数字化工具。从「凭经验管」升级成「看数据管」，向场长、基地经理方向走。
有车间班组长或项目管理经验的，转型有优势。简历上写清「管过多大团队、怎么排产、怎么抓质量安全」，比空谈热爱农业更有说服力。
招主管要考「现场调度 + 人员管理」：给个突发场景问怎么处理。会用数据工具、能跟工人打成一片、又扛得住安全的候选人最值钱。

ai_s7_trends: 规模化与数字化生产普及，主管从经验管理转向数据管理。
智能农机与无人设备减少一线体力岗位，管理岗位相对稳定。
食品安全与用工规范趋严，主管的安全与合规责任加重。

ai_impact_table.ai_s4_p: 6/10 说明修复与保护岗位「AI 明显介入、但替代不了核心」：档案、检测、图像分析正被 AI 大幅接管，而动手修复和方案决策依然依赖人的手艺与经验，这恰恰是岗位的核心价值。
ai_impact_table.ai_s4_p2: 高分更要用好工具：AI 检测和 3D 建模能显著提升诊断精度与保护水平，会用数字化工具的修复师能承担更复杂的项目，职业天花板更高；只会纯手工、不懂科技手段的人会逐渐边缘化。

ai_s5_persona.建议: 想走这条路，选文物保护与修复专业或文博专业，同时把化学、材料基础打扎实。要跟孩子讲清楚：培养周期长、编制岗位少，做好长期投入的准备，兴趣和耐心是第一位的。
把科技检测和数字化保护工具学起来：XRF 分析、3D 扫描、数字化建档，这些是新一代修复师的标配。多参与大项目、积累修复档案，资深修复师的稀缺性会越来越明显。
有化学、材料、艺术史背景的可以转。国内市场化修复机构和拍卖行在扩招，先做修复助理积累案例；面试时带上作品集和修复记录，比任何证书都有说服力。
修复人才稀缺是行业共识，别只盯着编制岗。用「项目制合作 + 技能培训 + 职称通道」吸引市场化人才，把老师傅的经验通过档案和标准化流程沉淀下来。

ai_s7_trends: 文博热与文物保护投入增加，修复人才缺口显现。
科技检测与数字化保护成为新一代修复师的标配。
市场化修复机构与民办博物馆提供补充就业通道。

body: 博物馆技术员与文物修复师运用专业方法对文物进行检测、保护与修复，负责藏品状态评估、修复方案实施、环境监测与展陈保护，保存并延续历史文化遗产的物理与美学价值。
career_ai_description_block.heading: AI 能一分钟重建文物的 3D 模型，但「这块碎片该用哪种材料粘、补配的线条该多深」——这些决定文物命运的细节，只有修复师的手知道。

ai_impact_table.ai_head_sub: AI can design optimal pipe routes and locate hidden leaks, but steady human hands are still needed for weld after weld inside pipe shafts.
ai_impact_table.ai_s1_bls: According to the U.S. Bureau of Labor Statistics (BLS), in 2024 about 504,500 plumbers, pipefitters, and steamfitters were employed. By 2034, employment is projected to reach 527,200, a net increase of about 22,700 jobs, with about 44,000 openings per year. In 2026, median annual pay was about $63,000 (BLS OOH, 2026).
ai_impact_table.ai_s1_p: AI will not replace plumbers, but it will change how jobs are acquired and performed. Quoting, scheduling, drawings, and leak detection are becoming digital. AI and robots cannot soon replace on-site skills such as welding, connecting, and working in confined spaces. This is a classic AI-assisted, human-executed occupation.
ai_s2_accel: Borescope pipeline robots that directly locate blockages hidden from view
Acoustic/thermal-imaging AI leak detection that finds leaks without opening walls
BIM clash detection that identifies pipe conflicts early and reduces rework
Smart water-meter data analysis that remotely identifies abnormal usage
ai_s2_auto: Digital drawings and layout, with CAD/BIM directly generating pipe-routing plans
Automatic material lists and quotes without manual calculations
Job scheduling and dispatch systems that automatically assign technicians and hours
Digital maintenance records and customer files
ai_s3_list: Hands-on field skills: threading, welding, and heat fusion each require tactile judgment that machines cannot fully automate.
Judgment in confined spaces: experience determines how to turn and apply force while crouching inside a pipe shaft.
Fault diagnosis and emergency repair decisions: one second of hesitation about which valve to close first and how to limit damage creates losses.
Owner communication and quoting: explain technical problems in understandable language and present convincing prices.
Safety and quality limits: every connection in a gas pipeline affects the safety of an entire building.
ai_impact_table.ai_s4_p: 4/10 indicates that software is taking over desk tasks such as drawings, quotes, and scheduling, while automation of core field skills remains limited.
ai_impact_table.ai_s4_p2: Moderately high exposure does not mean no change. AI leak detection, BIM prefabrication, and smart water meters will change work and eliminate workers who only use brute force without interpreting data. For technicians who read drawings and use tools, AI is a labor-saving aid rather than a competitor.

ai_s5_persona.建议: Skilled trades are among the few careers that become more valuable with age. Study water supply, drainage, or plumbing at a technical school, learn diligently from experienced workers during apprenticeship, earn credentials, and learn drawing interpretation. Do not chase quick money; the first three years are your investment.

Learn BIM drawing interpretation, pipeline inspection instruments, and smart leak-detection tools to combine craftsmanship + data expertise. Earn higher-level and crew-lead credentials and advance toward project management and team leadership.

Thirty is not too late to enter plumbing. The key is finding someone willing to train you. Begin as an apprentice, build credentials and skills, and specify the systems you independently completed and emergency repairs you handled on your resume.

Do not hire based on years alone. Assess completed work, including system acceptance records and representative emergency repairs. Add digital-tool use to the skill model and prioritize technicians who read BIM drawings.

ai_s6_tools.代表能力: Three-dimensional routing, clash detection, and prefabrication drawings
Locate blockages and damage without demolition
AI-assisted water-leak detection that reduces wall demolition
Remote identification of abnormal water use to support troubleshooting
Quote templates, scheduling and dispatch, and maintenance records
Overlay BIM models on the site to guide pipe routing
Automatically record pressure-test curves and generate reports
Answers to common questions and onsite appointment scheduling

ai_s7_trends: As BIM + prefabricated installation spread, on-site routing gradually becomes assembly-based. Welding volume decreases while precision requirements rise.
Smart leak detection and pipeline robots become standard maintenance tools, ending the era of opening walls to find leaks.
Household pipeline monitoring becomes smarter, shifting repairs from fixing failures to early warnings.

body: Plumbers, pipefitters, and steamfitters install, repair, and maintain water supply, drainage, heating, gas, and other piping. They route pipes from drawings, weld and connect them, conduct pressure tests, and handle emergency repairs, making them essential skilled workers in construction and manufacturing.

ai_impact_table.ai_head_sub: AI 能画出最优管线、定位隐藏漏点，但蹲在管道井里那一下一下的焊接，还得靠人的手稳。
ai_impact_table.ai_s1_bls: 美国劳工统计局（BLS） 的数据显示，2024 年管道工、配管工与蒸汽管安装工在岗约 50.45 万人，到 2034 年预计升至 52.72 万人，净增约 2.27 万个岗位，年均产生约 4.40 万个职位空缺，2026 年中位数年薪约 6.30 万美元（BLS OOH，2026）。
ai_impact_table.ai_s1_p: AI 不会取代管道工，但会改变「接活」和「干活」的方式。报价、排单、图纸、检漏这些环节正在数字化；焊接、连接、狭小空间作业这种现场手艺，短期内 AI 和机器人替代不了。这个岗位是典型的「AI 辅助、人落地」。
ai_s2_accel: 管道机器人内窥检测，肉眼看不到的堵点直接定位
声学/热成像 AI 检漏，不用凿墙就能找漏点
BIM 碰撞检查提前发现管线打架，减少返工
智能水表数据分析，远程发现异常用水
ai_s2_auto: 图纸与放线数字化，CAD/BIM 直接导出布管方案
材料清单与报价自动生成，不再手算
排单派工系统自动分配师傅与工时
维保记录与客户档案电子化
ai_s3_list: 现场手工技艺：套丝、焊接、热熔，每一道都考手感，机器还做不到全自动。
空间受限下的判断：管道井里半蹲着干活，怎么转身、怎么借力，靠经验。
故障诊断与抢修决策：先关哪个阀、怎么止损，现场一秒的犹豫都是损失。
与业主的沟通与报价：把技术问题讲成业主听得懂的话，把报价报得让人服气。
安全与质量底线：燃气管道的每一道连接，都关系整栋楼的安全。
ai_impact_table.ai_s4_p: 4/10 说明这个职业的桌面任务——图纸、报价、排单——正被数字化接管，而现场核心手艺的自动化程度还不高。
ai_impact_table.ai_s4_p2: 中高曝光不等于零变化：AI 检漏、BIM 预制、智能水表会改变作业方式，也会淘汰「只会蛮干、不会看数据」的工人。对会看图、会用工具的师傅来说，AI 是省力工具，不是竞争对手。

ai_s5_persona.建议: 技术工种是少有的「越老越吃香」路线。读技校选给排水/水暖专业，学徒期踏实跟师傅学，考证书、学看图，别急着赚快钱，前三年是本金。
把 BIM 看图、管道检测仪和智能检漏工具用起来，向「会手艺 + 懂数据」升级。同时考等级证书和带班资质，往项目管理和带团队方向走。
三十岁转行学管道并不晚，关键是找到肯带你的师傅。先做学徒，把证书和手艺攒齐，简历上写清你独立完成过哪些系统、处理过哪些抢修。
招人别只看年限，要看「作品」——他布过的系统验收记录、抢修过的典型故障。能力模型要加上数字化工具使用，会看 BIM 图的师傅优先。

ai_s6_tools.代表能力: 三维布管、碰撞检查、预制件出图
不破拆定位堵塞与破损
AI 辅助识别漏水点，减少凿墙
远程发现异常用水，辅助排查
报价模板、排单派工、维保记录
把 BIM 模型叠到现场，指导布管
自动记录试压曲线，出具报告
常见问题答疑、预约上门

ai_s7_trends: BIM + 预制化安装普及，现场布管逐步变成「装配式」，焊接量减少但精度要求更高。
智能检漏与管道机器人成为维修标配，「凿墙找漏」的时代结束。
家庭管道监测走向智能化，维修市场从「坏了再修」转向「提前预警」。

body: 管道工、配管工与蒸汽管安装工负责供水、排水、供暖、燃气等管道的安装、维修与维护，包括按图布管、焊接连接、压力测试与故障抢修，是建筑业和制造业不可或缺的技术工。
career_ai_description_block.heading: AI 能画出最优管线、定位隐藏漏点，但蹲在管道井里那一下一下的焊接，还得靠人的手稳。

ai_impact_table.ai_head_sub: AI can help analyze assessments, organize literature, and generate counseling notes, but an understanding of what the person across from you truly needs must come from someone present.
ai_impact_table.ai_s1_bls: According to the U.S. Bureau of Labor Statistics (BLS), about 55,300 psychologists were employed in 2024, projected to rise to 57,700 by 2034, a net increase of about 2,400 jobs, with about 3,900 openings annually and median annual pay of about $117,600 in 2026 (BLS OOH, 2026).
ai_impact_table.ai_s1_p: AI will not replace psychologists, but it will change how they work. AI can perform assessment analysis, literature searches, report writing, and even preliminary conversation practice, concentrating professional value in the therapeutic relationship, clinical judgment, and intervention planning. AI could take over some simple emotional-support conversations, but in-depth counseling and treatment still depend on trained professionals.
ai_s2_accel: AI conversation practice and virtual-client training
Emotion recognition to support assessment
Online counseling platforms route mild cases
Case-data tracking and risk alerts
ai_s2_auto: Automatic scoring and analysis of psychological assessments
Literature searches and review generation
Standardized counseling notes and report templates
Visual reports for assessment data
ai_s3_list: Therapeutic relationship: help clients trust and open up.
Clinical judgment: interpret symptoms and the personal history behind them.
Deep empathy: understand suffering that cannot be quantified.
Ethical boundaries: manage privacy, referrals, and professional responsibility.
Intervention experience: know when to push and when to wait.
ai_impact_table.ai_s4_p: 5/10 indicates that psychology is a professional service occupation with medium AI exposure. AI accelerates data-related work such as assessments, literature, and records, and could take over some mild emotional-support conversations. However, moderately high exposure does not mean high risk: AI cannot replace therapeutic relationships or clinical judgment, and core demand for professional psychological services is growing.
ai_impact_table.ai_s4_p2: Moderately high exposure means professionals should use tools well. Apply AI to assessment analysis and documentation, leaving more time for clients, and use AI conversation practice as a training tool. Counselors who improve efficiency with technology while preserving relational depth will advance further in the field.

ai_s5_persona.建议: Students considering psychology should first choose between clinical counseling and research. Clinical work requires graduate study, training, and accumulated supervision hours, creating a long investment cycle. Build a solid undergraduate foundation and gain real practice early through internships or volunteer hotlines to confirm whether the work truly suits you.

Develop deep expertise in a systematic modality such as CBT or psychoanalysis, and continue personal therapy and supervision. Use AI tools for assessment and documentation, leaving time for clients. Online practice and EAP are growth directions worth pursuing.

Career changers must accept a long cycle of substantial investment: systematic training + personal therapy + supervision hours are all essential. Start as a hotline volunteer or psychology assistant to gain experience, and clarify why you want this career. People with weak motivations often cannot sustain it.

Good counselors are difficult to recruit and retain. Provide strong supervision support and career-development pathways instead of evaluating only counseling volume. AI assessment and documentation tools reduce administrative burdens and let professionals focus on counseling quality, which is key to retention.

ai_s6_tools.代表能力: Emotional reference from speech and text

ai_s7_trends: Mental-health demand continues growing, expanding psychology roles in schools, companies, and hospitals.
AI assessment and online counseling spread, routing mild cases while people provide in-depth counseling.
EAP and digital mental-health products broaden opportunities for psychologists.

body: Psychologists study human behavior and mental processes, provide psychological counseling and treatment, assessment, behavioral intervention, and scientific research, help individuals improve emotional and behavioral problems, and provide psychological expertise to organizations and public policy.

ai_impact_table.ai_head_sub: AI 能帮你做量表分析、整理文献、生成咨询记录，但「对面这个人现在真正需要什么」——那份理解，需要在场的人给出。
ai_impact_table.ai_s1_bls: 美国劳工统计局（BLS） 的数据显示，2024 年心理学家在岗约 5.53 万人，到 2034 年预计升至 5.77 万人，净增约 0.24 万个岗位，年均产生约 0.39 万个职位空缺，2026 年中位数年薪约 11.76 万美元（BLS OOH，2026）。
ai_impact_table.ai_s1_p: AI 不会取代心理学家，但会改变工作方式：量表分析、文献检索、报告撰写甚至初步的对话练习都能由 AI 完成，专业人员的价值更集中在咨询关系、临床判断和干预方案上。简单的情感支持类对话可能被 AI 分走一部分，但深度咨询与治疗依然依赖专业的人。
ai_s2_accel: AI 对话练习与虚拟来访者训练
情绪识别辅助评估
线上咨询平台分流轻症需求
个案数据追踪与风险预警
ai_s2_auto: 心理量表自动计分与分析
文献检索与综述生成
咨询记录与报告模板化
评估数据可视化报表
ai_s3_list: 咨询关系：让来访者信任并敞开。
临床判断：症状与背后的个人史判断。
深度共情：理解无法量化的痛苦。
伦理边界：隐私、转介与专业责任的把握。
干预经验：什么时候该推、什么时候该等。
ai_impact_table.ai_s4_p: 5/10 说明心理学属于「中等 AI 曝光」的专业服务岗位：评估、文献、记录这些数据环节能被 AI 加速，轻度的情绪支持对话也可能被 AI 分走。但中高曝光不等于高风险——咨询关系和临床判断是 AI 替代不了的，专业心理服务的核心需求反而在增长。
ai_impact_table.ai_s4_p2: 中高曝光意味着要善用工具：把 AI 用在评估分析和文书处理上，把时间留给来访者；同时把 AI 对话练习当成训练工具。会用技术提升效率、又能守住关系深度的咨询师，会是行业里走得更远的那批。

ai_s5_persona.建议: 孩子想学心理，要先想清楚走临床咨询还是研究路线：临床要读研、受训、攒督导时数，投入周期长；建议本科打好基础，尽早接触真实实践（实习、志愿热线），确认自己是否真的受得了这份工作。
往系统流派深耕（CBT、精神分析等），坚持个人体验和督导；把 AI 工具用于评估与文书，把时间留给来访者。线上执业与 EAP 是增长方向，值得布局。
非科班转咨询师要接受「长周期重投入」：系统培训 + 个人体验 + 督导时数一个都不能少。可以先从热线志愿者、心理助理做起积累，同时想清楚自己为什么想干这行——这行撑不下去的往往是动机不纯的人。
好的咨询师难招难留，建议给足督导支持和职业发展通道，别只按咨询量考核；配 AI 评估与文书工具减轻行政负担，让专业人才把精力放在咨询质量上，这是留住人才的关键。

ai_s7_trends: 心理健康需求持续增长，学校企业医院心理岗扩张。
AI 评估与线上咨询普及，轻症分流、深度咨询靠人。
EAP 与数字心理健康产品扩大心理学家的用武之地。

body: 心理学家研究人类行为与心理过程，开展心理咨询与治疗、心理评估、行为干预与科学研究，帮助个体改善情绪与行为问题，并为组织与公共政策提供心理学专业支持。

ai_impact_table.ai_head_sub: AI can analyze read-rate data and recommend parameter changes automatically, but antenna orientation and metal interference still require experts to test the warehouse inch by inch.
ai_impact_table.ai_s1_bls: According to the U.S. Bureau of Labor Statistics (BLS), about 95,900 RFID specialists were employed in 2024, rising to a projected 101,800 by 2034, a net increase of about 5,900 jobs, with approximately 5,700 openings annually. Median annual pay was about $127,600 in 2026 (BLS OOH, 2026).
ai_impact_table.ai_s1_p: AI will not replace RFID device specialists, but it will take over test-data analysis. AI can calculate read rates, identify abnormal locations, and recommend parameter optimization, shifting specialists from repeated testing toward designing solutions and validating results. Field deployment, interference troubleshooting, and client communication still depend heavily on human experience.
ai_s2_accel: AI-assisted recommendations for antenna coverage and parameter optimization
Signal simulation reduces repeated field trial and error
Data-platform integration enables full-lifecycle tag tracking
Remote diagnostic tools quickly locate field faults
ai_s2_auto: Automatic collection and statistical analysis of read-rate test data
Automatic generation of test reports and configuration documents
Automatic marking of abnormal read locations
Bulk device-parameter configuration tools
ai_s3_list: Field interference troubleshooting: optimize for metal, liquids, and multipath environments.
Equipment selection judgment: understanding the setting is essential to choosing hardware.
Deployment engineering: antenna placement and cable routing require expertise.
Protocol and middleware knowledge: understand how tag data reaches systems.
Client communication: explain technical solutions in terms clients can accept and verify.
ai_impact_table.ai_s4_p: A score of 5/10 means AI is accelerating testing and analysis, while field RF experience remains the core barrier. The score reflects upgraded work methods as specialists shift from manual measurement toward solution design, data interpretation, and troubleshooting.
ai_impact_table.ai_s4_p2: Moderately high exposure does not mean danger. RFID specialists who use AI data analysis and signal simulation can optimize twice as efficiently and deliver more reliable solutions. Pure operators who only run mechanical tests without understanding principles face the greatest compression.

ai_s5_persona.建议: Study IoT, communications, or electronics and complete RF and antenna projects at university. RFID is specialized, so develop the combined strengths of RF + software + field work rather than focusing on one point.

Move from pure testing into solution design and project management, learning data-analysis and signal-simulation tools. Develop expertise in one or two industry settings such as retail, logistics, or healthcare to become an RFID specialist who understands the application and commands the strongest bargaining power.

People with communications, electronics, or software backgrounds can transition. RFID's entry barrier is moderate, but field skills matter. A resume describing interference problems solved and projects deployed is more useful than certificates.

RFID specialists are difficult to recruit. Retain them through project participation + field-travel allowances + skills training. Field deployment experts who work independently deserve premium pay; do not hire only for testing roles.

ai_s6_tools.代表能力: Power, frequency, and protocol parameter configuration

ai_s7_trends: RFID applications expand from retail and logistics into healthcare, manufacturing, and asset management, sustaining market growth.
AI data analysis and signal simulation become standard, shifting specialists toward solution design and result validation.
Demand rises for hybrid RF + software + application talent, while pure testing roles contract.

body: RFID device specialists select equipment, configure parameters, test, validate, deploy, and troubleshoot RFID systems, ensuring electronic tags and readers identify reliably in complex environments.

ai_impact_table.ai_head_sub: AI 能自动分析读取率数据、给出调参建议，但天线朝向、金属干扰这些现场玄学，还得靠专家蹲在仓库里一寸寸试。
ai_impact_table.ai_s1_bls: 美国劳工统计局（BLS） 的数据显示，2024 年电台专员在岗约 9.59 万人，到 2034 年预计升至 10.18 万人，净增约 0.59 万个岗位，年均产生约 0.57 万个职位空缺，2026 年中位数年薪约 12.76 万美元（BLS OOH，2026）。
ai_impact_table.ai_s1_p: AI 不会取代 RFID 设备专家，但会接管测试数据分析：AI 能自动统计读取率、识别异常点位、给出参数优化建议，专家的角色从「反复试」变成「定方案、验结果」。现场部署、抗干扰排查和客户沟通，依然高度依赖人的经验。
ai_s2_accel: AI 辅助天线覆盖与参数优化建议
信号仿真减少现场反复试错
数据平台联动实现标签全流程追踪
远程诊断工具快速定位现场故障
ai_s2_auto: 读取率测试数据的自动采集与统计
测试报告与配置文档的自动生成
异常读取点位的自动标记
设备参数批量配置工具
ai_s3_list: 现场抗干扰排查：金属、液体、多路径环境的调优。
设备选型判断：懂场景才能选对硬件。
部署工程能力：天线怎么装、线怎么走，都是功夫。
协议与中间件知识：标签数据怎么到系统手里。
客户沟通：把技术方案讲得客户能验收。
ai_impact_table.ai_s4_p: 5/10 说明这行的「测试与分析」环节正被 AI 提速，但「射频现场经验」仍是核心壁垒；评分反映的是工作方式升级——专家从「手动测」转向「定方案、看数据、排故障」。
ai_impact_table.ai_s4_p2: 中高曝光不等于危险：会用 AI 数据分析、信号仿真工具的 RFID 专家，调优效率翻倍、方案更可靠。真正被压缩的是「只会机械测试、不懂原理」的纯操作岗。

ai_s5_persona.建议: 选物联网、通信或电子类专业，大学多做射频和天线相关项目。RFID 是细分领域，建议孩子把「射频 + 软件 + 现场」的复合能力都练起来，别只盯一个点。
从纯测试岗转向方案设计和项目管理，学数据分析工具和信号仿真。深耕一两个行业场景（零售、物流、医疗），成为「懂场景的 RFID 专家」议价力最强。
有通信、电子或软件背景的都可以转，RFID 门槛不算高但要求现场能力。简历上突出你排过什么干扰、部署过什么项目，比证书更有用。
RFID 人才细分难招，用「项目参与 + 现场出差补贴 + 技能培训」留人；能独当一面的现场部署专家值得高薪，别只招纯测试岗。

ai_s6_tools.代表能力: 功率、频率、协议参数配置
标签响应与回波损耗测量
读取率统计与异常标记
标签数据过滤与系统对接

ai_s7_trends: RFID 应用从零售物流扩展到医疗、制造与资产管理，市场持续扩容。
AI 数据分析与信号仿真成为标配，专家转向方案设计与结果验证。
「射频 + 软件 + 场景」的复合人才需求上升，纯测试岗收缩。

body: RFID 设备专家负责 RFID（射频识别）系统的设备选型、参数配置、测试验证、现场部署与故障排查，确保电子标签与读写器在复杂环境中稳定可靠地完成识别。

ai_impact_table.ai_head_sub: AI can reconcile accounts automatically, weigh visually, and count by scanning, but when a driver says the truck definitely carries 500 boxes and the system says 495, someone still has to resolve the discrepancy on site. That person is you.
ai_impact_table.ai_s1_bls: According to the U.S. Bureau of Labor Statistics (BLS), about 49,800 weighers, measurers, checkers, and samplers, recordkeeping, were employed in 2024, with employment projected to fall to 47,400 by 2034, a net loss of about 2,400 jobs. The occupation generates approximately 5,300 openings annually, and median annual pay was about $45,700 in 2026 (BLS OOH, 2026).
ai_impact_table.ai_s1_p: AI will not eliminate this occupation immediately, but it will take over weight readings, document entry, and reconciliation. People will still perform physical counts, handle exceptions, and verify samples in the near term, though the number of jobs will shrink.
ai_s2_accel: Visual weighing cameras automatically verify goods
AGVs support storage-location management
AI quality inspection identifies damaged cartons
RFID batch scanning replaces item-by-item counting
ai_s2_auto: Electronic scale readings automatically feed into systems
Barcode scanners count items automatically
Automatic reconciliation between documents and systems
Automatic generation of ledger reports
ai_s3_list: On-site exception handling: quickly resolve inventory discrepancies while several trucks wait.
Communication and coordination: manage input from drivers, warehouse staff, and dispatchers.
Sampling judgment: experience determines which batches to sample, how many items to take, and how to make samples representative.
Off-system troubleshooting: create temporary responses when equipment fails or documents are missing.
Responsibility: one incorrect entry can misalign the entire downstream chain.
ai_impact_table.ai_s4_p: A score of 4/10 reflects the occupation's heavy emphasis on weighing, entry, and reconciliation, which systems are taking over. People remain necessary for on-site verification and exception handling, so the role will contract gradually rather than disappear immediately.
ai_impact_table.ai_s4_p2: Moderate exposure does not guarantee safety. Standardized recordkeeping is among the first areas affected by AI and automation, with visual weighing and scan-based counting already replacing manual work. The greatest risk falls on people who perform mechanical checks without learning systems. Those who operate WMS and resolve exceptions can still advance into supervision.

ai_s5_persona.建议: Warehousing and logistics provide a low-barrier entry point, but should not be the final destination. Study logistics management or supply chains and learn WMS and data analysis. Future warehouses need people who manage systems, not people who only count.

Assign repetitive scanning and weighing to systems and proactively learn advanced WMS functions and inventory analysis. Move toward warehouse supervisor, quality supervisor, or logistics dispatcher and advance from operations to management within two years.

Transitioning into warehousing is quick, but understand that automation is pressuring these roles. Learn system operation and inventory analysis as soon as you join, shifting from a pair of hands to someone who knows how to use systems.

Instead of hiring many people for mechanical verification, deploy visual weighing and scanning and assign people to exception handling and inventory analysis. Prioritize system skills and responsibility over raw speed when hiring.

ai_s6_tools.代表能力: Automatically compare documents and system records

ai_s7_trends: Visual weighing, scan-based counting, and system reconciliation are widespread, substantially shrinking purely manual weighing and counting roles.
Warehouse management is advancing toward automation equipment and data analysis, favoring people with WMS and inventory-analysis skills.
Exception handling and on-site coordination are becoming the core value of retained roles, while mechanical verification is replaced.

ai_impact_table.ai_head_sub: AI 能自动对账、视觉称重、扫码清点，但司机说「我这车货明明是 500 箱」而系统是 495 箱时，谁来现场把这件事弄明白？还是你。
ai_impact_table.ai_s1_bls: 美国劳工统计局（BLS） 的数据显示，2024 年称重员、测量员、核查员、采样员、记录在岗约 4.98 万人，到 2034 年预计升至 4.74 万人，岗位净减约 0.24 万个，年均产生约 0.53 万个职位空缺，2026 年中位数年薪约 4.57 万美元（BLS OOH，2026）。
ai_impact_table.ai_s1_p: AI 不会让这个岗位立刻消失，但会接管称重读数、单据录入和对账。剩下的现场点数、异常处理、抽样核实，短期内还要靠人，但岗位数量会收缩。
ai_s2_accel: 视觉称重相机自动验货
AGV 小车配合库位管理
AI 质检识别破损外箱
RFID 批量扫描代替逐件点数
ai_s2_auto: 电子秤读数自动回传系统
扫码枪自动清点计数
单据与系统自动对账
台账报表自动生成
ai_s3_list: 异常现场处理：账实不符时，怎么在几辆车排队的情况下快速查清。
沟通协调：司机、仓管、调度三方的话都要接得住。
抽样判断：哪批要抽、抽几件、怎么抽才有代表性，是经验。
系统外的救火：设备故障、单据缺失时的临时处置。
责任心：一笔数据录错，后面整条链都对不上。
ai_impact_table.ai_s4_p: 4/10 说明这个职业的称重、录入、对账比重偏高，这些正被系统接管；但现场核实与异常处置仍需人，属于「逐步收缩但不会瞬间消失」的岗位。
ai_impact_table.ai_s4_p2: 中高曝光不等于高枕无忧。这类标准化记录岗正是 AI 和自动化最先动手的地方——视觉称重、扫码清点已经在替代「称重点数」。真正要担心的是只做机械核对不学系统的人；会操作 WMS、能处理异常的，还能往主管走。

ai_s5_persona.建议: 仓储物流是低门槛入行口，但别把它当终点。学物流管理或供应链相关专业，把 WMS、数据分析学起来——未来仓储缺的是会管系统的人，不是只点数的人。
把扫码、称重这些重复活交给系统，主动学 WMS 进阶功能和库存分析。往仓库主管、质检主管、物流调度走，两年内完成从「操作岗」到「管理岗」的升级。
转行进仓储快，但要有心理准备：这类岗正在被自动化挤压。入职后尽快学系统操作和盘点分析，把自己从「手」变成「会用系统的人」，才稳。
与其招一堆做机械核对的，不如上视觉称重加扫码，把人配在异常处理和盘点分析上。招人时优先看会不会用系统、有没有责任心，这两点比手脚快更重要。

ai_s7_trends: 视觉称重、扫码清点、系统对账全面普及，纯人工称点岗显著收缩。
仓库管理向「自动化设备 + 数据分析」升级，会 WMS 与库存分析的人吃香。
异常处理与现场协调成为留存岗位的核心价值，机械核对被替代。

body: 称重计量工是称重员、测量员、核查员、采样员（记录）在仓储物流与生产环节负责货物的称重、计量、点数核查、单据核对与抽样记录，并完成系统台账录入。
